GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT
Secretariat Service Transfers and Postings of Officers in the Secretariat Departments
Competent authority – Orders – Issued.
GENERAL ADMINISTRATION (SERVICES-A) DEPARTMENT
G.O.Ms.No.19
Read the following:
Dated: 09-02-2018
1. G.O.Ms.No.304, General Administration (Ser.A) Department, Dt.17-09-2009.
***
ORDER:
1. Government have examined the question of competent authority for ordering transfers and
postings of officers in the Secretariat Departments.
2. Government hereby order as follows:
(i) Transfers and postings of Assistant Secretaries and officers above that rank in the
Secretariat Departments shall be ordered by the General Administration (Ser.A) Department
only.
(ii) Transfers and postings of Section Officers, Assistant Section Officers and other staff
within a Secretariat Department shall be ordered by the Secretary to Government of that
Department.
(iii) No officer below the rank of Secretary to Government shall order transfers of Section
Officers.
3. These orders shall come into force with immediate effect.
(BY ORDER AND IN THE NAME OF THE GOVERNOR OF ANDHRA PRADESH)
To
N. PADMAVATHI
SECRETARY TO GOVERNMENT (SER.)
All Departments of Secretariat.
Copy to:
The Secretary, A.P. Public Service Commission.
//FORWARDED :: BY ORDER//
SECTION OFFICER
